atlas_label_AAL3v1.Description: Derived for NEMAR (2026-10-08), not given by the authors: label of the AAL3v1 atlas (Rolls et al. 2020, MNI152, 1 mm) at the contact position, nearest labelled voxel within 4 mm, else n/a. MNI coordinates used as given. Coordinates in this file are unchanged.

atlas_label_DesikanKilliany.Description: Derived for NEMAR (2026-10-08), not given by the authors: label of FreeSurfer fsaverage mri/aparc+aseg.mgz (Desikan-Killiany cortical parcels + aseg structures, MNI305 space; the MNI152/MNI305 difference is ignored) at the contact position; cortical/subcortical label within 4 mm if the voxel is unlabelled, white-matter labels kept as such, else n/a. MNI coordinates used as given.
